description: Released recording-transfer sealer wheels that may be installed on rig hosts. One entry per version; adding a version is a reviewed commit. install_recording_transfer.sh refuses any wheel whose sha256 differs from its entry.

releases.notes: Last release built from the Citrus repository; kept installed as the rollback for the 3.1.0 cutover (approved 2026-10-10). Matches Orange's pin.
